title: Project Kickoff & Tech Stack Decision
transcript:
John: Let's kickoff the Smart Meeting Summary project.
Sarah: What is the tech stack?
John: We will use Node.js and Express for the backend, and React for the frontend.
Mike: Let's use TailwindCSS for styling if possible, but keep vanilla CSS as fallback. For AI, we'll use Mistral AI.
Sarah: I will setup the repo and backend structure.

decisions: Use Mistral AI for AI features

action_items.task: Setup the repo and backend structure

title: UI Design Sync & Setup
transcript:
John: Let's review UI progress.
Mike: I have setup the React structure with Vite. I will build the initial components by Tuesday.
Sarah: The backend APIs for summarization are ready, but we need to implement RAG next.
John: We'll implement a file-based RAG using TF-IDF for cosine similarity to find relevant meetings. Let's aim to complete the integration by Friday.

decisions: Use file-based RAG with TF-IDF and cosine similarity

title: Meeting: finalize the Sprint 8 tasks (Jun 26, 2026)
transcript:
Meeting: Sprint Planning - Mobile App
Date: July 15, 2026

John (Project Manager):
Good morning everyone. Today's agenda is to finalize the Sprint 8 tasks and confirm the release timeline.

Sarah (Backend Developer):
The authentication APIs are completed and tested. They're ready for integration.

Mike (Frontend Developer):
The dashboard UI is about 80% complete. I need two more days to finish the remaining components.

Emily (QA Engineer):
Testing of the login flow is complete. I found two minor bugs in the dashboard that need to be fixed before release.

John:
Considering the remaining frontend work and QA fixes, I propose moving the release from July 20 to July 23.

Everyone:
Agreed.

Sarah:
I'll help Mike integrate the authentication APIs by tomorrow.

Mike:
I'll complete the dashboard UI by July 17.

Emily:
I'll start full regression testing on July 18 and submit the QA report by July 19.

John:
Great. We'll have our next status meeting on July 18.

decisions: move the release from July 20 to July 23

action_items.task: help Mike integrate the authentication APIs
